schedule.policyPending: Apply the current chat policy before adding or resuming tasks.
schedule.noChats: Allow a chat in Chats before adding a task.
schedule.taskHelp: This message is sent to Pi at the scheduled time, using the chat’s existing model and tool permissions.
schedule.taskPlaceholder: For example: summarize today’s technology news.
schedule.timeHelp: Time zone: {{zone}} (this browser). Review the UTC offset below, especially around daylight-saving changes.
schedule.repeatHelp: Repeats use fixed elapsed intervals, not cron or a fixed local clock time. Missed intervals are skipped; there is no catch-up burst.
schedule.interruptedHelp: The process stopped during this attempt. It will not be resubmitted. Pi may still recover admitted work or its reply. Inspect the chat before creating a replacement; this entry cannot be resumed.
schedule.failedHelp: Execution or delivery could not be confirmed. Review the chat and any side effects before scheduling again. Resuming a repeating task only schedules its next future interval.
schedule.pauseRunningHelp: Pausing does not stop this running or queued attempt.
schedule.resumeOverdue: This one-time task is overdue. Resuming will run it as soon as the dispatcher is available. Continue?
schedule.resumeConfirm: Resume this task? Repeating tasks skip missed intervals and continue at the next future interval.
schedule.deleteConfirm: Delete this schedule? This cannot be undone. Work already dispatched is not cancelled and may still send a reply.
schedule.executionHelp: Tasks run while the bot is online and may wait for the current chat turn. Pause and delete prevent future dispatches, not work already dispatched. One-time tasks missed while offline run once on return. A successful reply is not proof that every requested action succeeded. Replies go to the target chat.
schedule.invalidTime: Enter a valid local date and time. Nonexistent daylight-saving times are not accepted.
schedule.loadFailed: Could not load tasks. Refresh to try again.
schedule.operationFailed: Could not confirm the operation. Refresh and check before retrying.
